description: Read one message sent to an agent's own address, in full plain text, as that agent acting for the person whose mailbox received it. GET /internal/mail/agents/:agent_id/messages/:message_id answers mail.agent-inbox-message@1: the sender, the addresses the mail server stamped at delivery, the subject, the text cut to 4000 characters, and the two threading headers a reply needs. Never the HTML and never an attachment. The token must name the person (on_behalf_of), the agent must be one of that person's inboxes, and the message must have been delivered to that address; anything else is the same 404 as a message that does not exist. Loopback only; granted to OpenVibe.Actor alone, which reads a letter and answers it under the person's approval policy.
